column1: # Exports of Ridom SeqSphere+ that replace kansasii-mst / kansasii-cgmlst (numbers as in kansasii-docs/docs/RIDOM.md).
# Only what a script cannot derive from the other exports is listed. Everything else is computed by scripts/03-08 (see README).
# file     : name in data/imm/ ({subset} is replaced by each subset below)
# id_column: column with the Sample ID (empty = presence only; `labels` = the labels of a .meg matrix)
# cohort   : keep = isolates of the cohort without `excluded` (174); pool = also those excluded only by low coverage (M055, 175)
# refs     : yes = the 7 public GTDB references (GCF_*) must be in the file too
# subsets  : none = one file; else one file per subset of SUBSETS in common.py
# replaces : what the export serves / the scripts derived from it

column7: allele profiles: 04_qc (per-isolate QC, failed targets, locus stats), shared_loci_*.csv
allele distances: 02 (subsets), 05 (cluster threshold), 06 (MST nodes / edges, UPGMA trees), 07 (controls)
MST figures drawn by SeqSphere+ (layout and colours are not reproducible in code)
Ridom's MST clusters: 05 (threshold, singletons, nearest neighbours)
scheme + Target Definer report: 03 (targets, filters, settings, parameters.txt)
